text:
ana_cs: Quick note on MarinerEdge onboarding — 95p latency ~2.2s, token cost ~1.5x forecast. Renewal in 6 weeks. Propose low-risk pilot (quant + model hop + routed canary). Thoughts?

mike_se: +1. Recommend 3% canary to redwood-int8-lite for /summarize-short; route >800 tokens to fp16. Enable KV cache for repeated templates to reduce tails.

rey_ml: Ran 80 seed prompts: int8 median semantic cosine 0.984 vs baseline. Most diffs are formatting; factual drift rare. Suggest semantic gate >=0.98, 48h A/B canary, rollback on semantic drop or latency regressions.

jo_sre: Ops note: tenant on shared-us-west. I'll provision canary nodes and dashboard tiles, enable KV prefix cache, and add alerts: semantic < 0.98 (20m) and 95p > 1800ms (15m).

tara_pm: Capture a one-pager for renewal: est token savings 20-28% and 95p latency down ~15-22%. Add a 1-question pulse after pilot: "Was response speed acceptable? (yes / mostly / no)".

# routing snippet (mike_se):
```
route: "marineredge-summarize"
policy:
  - condition: tokens(input) < 300 and rand() < 0.03
    target: redwood-int8-lite
  - condition: tokens(input) >= 300 and tokens(input) < 800
    target: redwood-fp16-stable
fallback:
  - on_semantic_cosine_lt: 0.98
    action: route_to redwood-fp16-stable
  - on_latency_gt: 1800ms
    action: route_to redwood-dedicated-lowlatency
```

ana_cs: Timeline: start Tue 09:00 PT, monitor 48h, mid-sync Wed EOD. I'll send the customer note and book a 30m enablement. ops-bot: create #cs-marineredge-alerts.

ops-bot: alert created: channel=#cs-marineredge-alerts, semantic_cosine < 0.98 (20m), 95p_latency > 1800ms (15m). owner: jo_sre.

ana_cs: Thanks team — will share pilot brief and calendar invites. :thumbsup:
